title: Expressive applicability with coordinator corrections — 09
scope: Finite design-applicability checkpoint. Observations are kept separate from conditional creative recommendations. Original lyrics, audio and author intent were not reviewed; none of these records accepts a template.
global_limits: The stills establish appearances only at their recorded samples. They do not establish transitions, persistence, motion curves, song sections, beat synchronization, emotional intent, audience response or author intent.

Worker-captioned visual descriptions remain explicitly labeled as candidates unless tied to a coordinator-viewed source still. Recommendations are design hypotheses for new work, not descriptions of how the source was meant to feel.
Lyrics, soundtrack, font identity and font licensing are unreviewed unless the record expressly says otherwise. Use original or separately licensed artwork and type.
Art patterns, motion observations and architecture coverage remain linked but separately counted; no motion form or accepted template is added here.
